title: The Tate conjecture for abelian fivefolds over finite fields
summary: We prove the Tate conjecture for abelian fivefolds over finite fields. The proof constructs correspondences for a residual motive using a Moret--Bailly family, Gross--Schoen heights, and monodromy. We also prove standard conjecture~$D_\ell$ over $\overline{\mathbf F}_p$ and independence of $\ell$ of rational cycle class kernels over algebraically closed fields of characteristic $p$. Over finite fields, rational and numerical equivalence agree with rational coefficients, and higher algebraic $K$-groups vanish rationally.
